description: Adds rows to a sheet. To add child rows under a parent row, give parentRowKey. Without parentRowKey, each row is a new record that is created in Maximo when a person commits: give every key column (for example SITEID and ASSETNUM) and the attributes Maximo requires, then add its child rows with parentRowKey set to the new row's key. Records that already exist in Maximo are not created again. Give one of rows (a few rows you write), from (rows taken inside the work screen from another sheet, such as an imported file, so that row data never passes through the AI) or children (child rows under several parents in one call and one undo batch). Values that are in another sheet (an import, or codes decided there with apply_rule) go with from, never copied into rows or children.

children.description: Child rows for several parents at once (up to 200 rows in all), e.g. failure report lines for many work orders. Without parentRowKey

from.description: Rows from another sheet: new records, or child rows with parent (without parentRowKey)

columns.description: Column of this sheet → column of the source sheet (e.g. {"ASSETNUM":"Asset No."}, or for child rows {"FAILUREREPORT.FAILURECODE":"PROBLEM"})

filter.description: Rows of the source sheet to take

attr.description: Attribute or column name. Join child attributes with a dot, e.g. EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE

onePerParent.description: With parent: at most one child row with these values per parent. A parent whose source rows give different values, or that already has such a child row with other values, is left out and counted (split, differs)

parent.description: Child rows: parent column of this sheet → column of the source sheet with its value (e.g. {"WONUM":"WONUM"}). Each source row goes under the one parent with that value; source rows with the same values make one child row, and child rows already there are not added again. Without parent, each source row is a new record (up to 200)

sheet.description: Sheet to take the rows from (for example an imported file)

values.description: Constants for every added row (e.g. {"SITEID":"KITA"}, or {"FAILUREREPORT.TYPE":"PROBLEM"})

name: add_rows
title: Add rows
